name: scroll4-animation
title: Scroll 4 Animation
description: A narrow column seen from its left edge. Each tile hinges on its top edge from −70° to 70° while stepping 500px toward the camera and back again on a 0.04s stagger — pages turning in sequence rather than all at once. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.
